pub type Raw
pub enum PageOutcome
  Page
  Gap
  Unavailable
  InvalidRequest
  RecordTooLarge
  Corrupt
  Unsupported
  pub const ALL: [Self; 7]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod service_error_code
  pub const HANDLER_ERROR: &str
  pub const INVALID_RESULT: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_VERSION: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_SERVICE: &str
  pub const UNKNOWN_METHOD: &str
  pub const WRONG_MODE: &str
  pub const CALLER_UNAVAILABLE: &str
  pub const IDENTITY_REQUIRED: &str
  pub const WRONG_USER: &str
  pub const POLICY_UNAVAILABLE: &str
  pub const FORBIDDEN: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 11]
pub const HISTORY_ERROR_CODES: [&str; 5]
pub const HISTORY_CURSOR_WORDS: [&str; 1]
pub struct Attestation
  by: String
  verified: bool
  hop: i64
  program: String
  host: String
  user: String
  exe: String
  uid: i64
  gid: i64
  pid: i64
  key: String
  mac: String
pub struct Record
  schema: i64
  time: String
  level: i64
  msg: String
  identity: Vec<Attestation>
  job: String
  attrs: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct Page
  outcome: PageOutcome
  records: Vec<Record>
  next: String
  at_end: bool
pub fn encode(v: &Record) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Record, Refusal>
pub use abstraction_frame::FrameTransport
pub struct ServiceError
  code: String
  message: String
pub enum CallError<E>
  Transport(E)
  Refusal(Refusal)
  Dispatch(&'static str)
  Service(ServiceError)
pub trait Sink
  type Error
  fn write(&self, record: Record) -> Result<(), Self::Error>
pub struct SinkClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait HistoryReader
  type Error
  fn read(&self, cursor: String, max_records: i64, max_bytes: i64) -> Result<Page, Self::Error>
pub struct HistoryReaderClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub trait HistoryObserver
  type Error
  fn observe(&self, cursor: String, max_records: i64, max_bytes: i64, wait_ms: i64) -> Result<Page, Self::Error>
pub struct HistoryObserverClient<T>
  pub fn new(transport: T) -> Self
  pub fn transport(&self) -> &T
pub mod internal
  pub fn micros_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
  pub fn wide_timestamp(text: &str) -> bool
